OppSalesMethodology.name: OppSalesMethodology
OppSalesMethodology.description: Represents the sales methodology record attached to an opportunity.

IsLocked.description: Indicates if the opportunity's sales methodology is locked (true) or not (false).

MayEdit.description: Indicates whether a user can edit the opportunity's sales methodology.

Name.description: The name of the opportunity's sales methodology.

OpportunityId.description: Required. The ID of the associated opportunity.

SalesMethodologyDefId.description: Required. The ID of the sales methodology definition record.

OppSalesMethodology.accessRules: To access this object turn on the userHasSalesMethodologyEnabled, OrgPreferences, SalesMethodologyPref, and PipelineInspectorUser permissions. To create, edit, or delete records, users must own the associated opportunity's parent opportunity.
